name: Genkit
description: Builds AI features and agent flows in JavaScript, Go or Python with typed flows, tool calling and a local dev UI for tracing, from Google.

skills.name: Typed Flows
skills.description: Defines AI workflows as typed, streamable functions that deploy to servers or serverless runtimes unchanged.

skills.name: Tool Calling
skills.description: Registers tools and retrievers that models invoke during a flow, with schema validation on inputs and outputs.

skills.name: Local Developer UI
skills.description: Inspects flow traces, prompts and model calls in a local UI to debug behavior before deploying to production.
